3.name: TEXT_COMDEFFREECOMPANYCREST_00101_TALK_ACTOR_A2
3.description: Add or remove company crest from gear.

6.name: TEXT_COMDEFFREECOMPANYCREST_00101_TALK_ACTOR_010
6.description: A crest is the mark of your company. It defines you and your companions. It sets you apart from all the other orders, confederations, brotherhoods, and syndicates.

7.name: TEXT_COMDEFFREECOMPANYCREST_00101_TALK_ACTOR_011
7.description: Not only can you design your very own crest, but you can have it painted across all your equipment, so your foes will know who it is who smote them.

8.name: TEXT_COMDEFFREECOMPANYCREST_00101_TALK_ACTOR_012
8.description: To design and apply a company crest, your company will first have to have earned the right to do so.

9.name: TEXT_COMDEFFREECOMPANYCREST_00101_TALK_ACTOR_013
9.description: You will also have to be the master of your free company, or be given the proper authority to edit company crests.

10.name: TEXT_COMDEFFREECOMPANYCREST_00101_TALK_ERR1
10.description: It does not appear that you belong to a free company. You cannot very well have a company crest without a company, can you?

12.name: TEXT_COMDEFFREECOMPANYCREST_00101_TALK_ERR3
12.description: Your free company does not appear to be on our register. If you wish to change your company's crest, I am afraid I cannot be of service.
